summary: Build an app to sell spray foam products: a simple storefront where customers can browse products and place orders, incorporating best-in-class UX/features inspired by competitor spray-foam service websites.
architectural_notes: Visual theme direction updated: user requests a more blue palette (may conflict with prior 'no blue/purple' guideline).
Competitor/benchmark reference corrected: use “Foam Daddy” as the primary inspiration/benchmark instead of Cold Country.

SMS/texting quote requests to phone number 204 526 5420 is not supported (no SMS integrations on current platform); alternatives are displaying phone number on quote page or storing inquiries in admin dashboard.
User requests “Ontario” to appear at the bottom of the site (likely footer), which may conflict with prior requirement to show only the phone number in the footer contact section.
User requests removing the “Serving Northwest(ern) Ontario” service-area text from the site (currently part of the header/service-area copy).
User requests removing the “Serving Ontario” service-area text from the site (may conflict with prior requirements to include “Ontario” in header/footer service-area copy).
known_issues: Customer-facing copy/content issue: under the Foam Daddy branding, the foam listing/section does not display 'Ontario' as expected (user reports missing 'Ontario' text).

Ambiguity: user request “at the bottom” needs confirmation whether to place “Ontario” in the footer contact section or another bottom-of-page area (to avoid conflicting with footer phone-only requirement).

Potential requirements conflict: user now requests removing “Serving Ontario” while prior requests/features require “Ontario” to be included in service-area copy (needs clarification on desired final service-area wording).

existing_features.title: Create a public storefront that lets customers browse spray foam products, view product details, and add items to a cart.
Implement checkout and order placement: collect customer contact and delivery information, show an order summary, and submit the order to the backend.
Add an owner/admin area protected by Internet Identity that allows managing products (create/edit/archive) and viewing incoming orders.

Apply a cohesive visual theme appropriate for an industrial building-materials storefront (no blue/purple palette): strong typography, high-contrast neutral palette, clear pricing/CTA hierarchy, and consistent spacing across pages.
Add generated static brand assets and use them in the UI (hero/banner and a simple logo). Store generated images under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.
Update the global Tailwind theme tokens to use a more blue-forward palette (primary, ring, accent, charts) while keeping text contrast accessible in both light and dark modes.
Adjust hero and key page accents so the storefront visually reads as ‘more blue’ (e.g., hero overlay/gradient tint and subtle background accents) without reducing product image legibility.

Update the storefront homepage to incorporate best-in-class spray-foam contractor website UX patterns inspired by: https://coldcountrysprayfoam.com, https://www.rrso.ca, https://www.beyondfoam.com, https://www.pbsprayfoam.com. Add above-the-fold CTAs and trust-building sections while keeping the existing product grid and shopping flow intact.
Add a dedicated “Request a Quote” page with a lead capture form suitable for spray-foam service inquiries (not product checkout). Include validation and a success state after submission.
Add an admin page for managing quote inquiries (leads) alongside existing admin products/orders, including status updates and basic inquiry details.
Add contractor-style “trust signals” and service-company footer/header improvements inspired by competitor sites, without adding external integrations (no email service, no live chat).

Replace all user-facing brand name references of “Cold Country Spray Foam” with “Foam Daddy” across the storefront UI, including headings, hero/service sections, testimonials copy, and confirmation messages.
Update shared layout brand elements to match the “Foam Daddy” name, including the header logo alt text and brand wordmark, and the footer company name/copyright line.
Update any internal default identifiers that embed the old brand slug (e.g., fallback hostname/app identifier strings) to use a Foam Daddy equivalent, while keeping behavior unchanged.
Remove the “Frequently Asked Questions” section (“Asked Questions”) and the “What Our Customers Say” testimonials section from the storefront homepage UI so they are no longer displayed to customers.
Update the footer "Contact Us" section to display nothing except the phone number "204 526 5420" (remove any email and location/service-area lines).
Remove non-phone contact options elsewhere in the customer-facing UI so that any "Contact"/"Prefer to speak with us" area shows only the phone number "204 526 5420" and no email address.

Ensure the customer-facing Foam Daddy brand lockup includes "Ontario" in the service-area copy by adding a short service-area subtitle under the "Foam Daddy" text in the site header (e.g., "Serving Manitoba & Northwestern Ontario") so customers can see Ontario is included without scrolling.

Update the customer-facing footer (bottom of the site) so it clearly includes the word “Ontario” in the Foam Daddy service-area copy at the bottom, matching the user request “at the bottom”. This should be visible in the footer brand/about area without changing the footer “Contact Us” section’s phone-only constraint.
Update customer-facing service-area copy to remove “Northwestern Ontario” phrasing wherever it appears, while keeping “Ontario” included in the service-area text.
Remove customer-facing service-area text that mentions Ontario (including the phrase "Serving Ontario") wherever it appears in the storefront UI.
Update the shared service-area copy constant and any dependent UI so the resulting sentences render with correct English punctuation/grammar after removing Ontario.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a spray foam sales app storefront with product browsing and customer order placement
Create backend data models and APIs to support: product catalog read access for customers and order creation/storage.
Update the UI visual theme to use a more blue color palette (adjust branding/theme to be bluer)
Review competitor spray-foam websites and incorporate the best UX/content features (layout, CTAs, trust signals, service highlights) into the storefront site
Implement backend support for storing and managing service quote inquiries (leads) submitted from the “Request a Quote” form, including an admin-only view/update capability.
Remove the “Asked Questions” (FAQ) section and the “What Our Customers Say” (testimonials) section from the storefront UI
Add a simple “Contact Us” page/section that displays only a phone number: 204 526 5420
Add “Ontario” service-area text at the bottom of the site (footer/bottom section) per user request
Remove the “Serving Northwest(ern) Ontario” service-area subtitle text from the customer-facing header/brand lockup
Remove the “Serving Ontario” service-area text from customer-facing UI copy (header/footer/sections) wherever it appears
